query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tobacco_compounds (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  compound_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  cas_number VARCHAR(50),
  chemical_class VARCHAR(100),
  category VARCHAR(100),
  landrace_source VARCHAR(100),
  concentration_ppm DECIMAL(10,4),
  concentration_percent DECIMAL(10,6),
  is_new_tobacco_isolate BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  aromatic_notes TEXT,
  perfumery_relevance TEXT,
  biosynthetic_pathway VARCHAR(100),
  related_molecule_id INT,
  source_reference VARCHAR(255),
  data_certainty ENUM('confirmed', 'hypothetical', 'estimated') DEFAULT 'hypothetical',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
